title: 第6章 神奇的能力
content_zh:
第一卷 恰同学少年 第六章 神奇的能力

浴缸里的苏林，惊奇地看着这一数字暴涨着。

“如果按照我先前的推测，我这个暂停时间的神奇能力是有限制的，就取决于这鲜红数字的大小，那么现在这个数字已经快涨到一百了，是不是说明现在我就又有了暂停时间的能力了？”

想到这里，苏林心里面一阵兴奋，他本来找叶星竹就是想要研究一下自己暂停时间的神奇能力。而现在，数字涨了回来，甚至数值上超过之前很多了，苏林怀着试一试的想法，在心里面再次默念了一声：“时间暂停。”

又是那种熟悉的感觉，时间暂停了，真的再次暂停了，苏林甚至看到了从竹姐姐发梢掉下的一颗晶莹的水珠停留在了半空中。

时间真的暂停了，同时，那右上角鲜红的数字也开始一秒一秒的递减。

不知道什么原因涨上去的数字又开始递减了，苏林可宝贵得紧这些数字，既然试验完毕了，赶紧在心里面再次默念一声：“时间恢复。”

倏地一下，时间又恢复了正常。方才叶母和叶星竹的争吵还在继续，不过叶星竹因为苏林在的缘故没有多说话，反而是叶母一直孜孜不倦地说着。

“竹儿……别的话，妈就不多说了，妈供了你这么多年也不容易。现在你工作了，能够自己养活自己，妈别的都不操心，唯一就操心你的终生大事。妈这些天已经和厂里的那些工友们都说了，让她们看看周围亲戚什么的，有没有不错的小伙子，有的话就介绍给你……”

叶母站了起来，提了提裤子，语重心长地说道。

但是，叶星竹却似乎十分反感，撅着嘴反驳道：“妈！我不要相亲，这都二十一世纪了，我自己的婚姻我自己做主。”

“得得得……让你自己做主，你工作都两三年了，也没见你带回来过谁？你看看隔壁家丽丽，今年都已经换了好几拨了，而且是一个比一个条件好……”

苏林静静听着对话，很显然，这是叶家母女经常争吵的话题。虽然苏林现在很想替竹姐姐说几句话，但是只要他一说话，可就完全暴露了。

“好了，臭妮子，妈也不说你了以后，你自己的事情，自己看着办，要是今年你还不能够找一个像样的小伙子回来，妈就给你安排相亲。妈做饭去了，你自己要弄赶紧弄，弄完出来吃饭好上班去……”

甩下一句话，叶母也不等叶星竹回答，就打开卫生间的门，自顾自地走到厨房做饭去了。

叶星竹有心再解释，可是叶母已经都出去了。而叶星竹低头看着苏林那带着坏笑又眨巴眨巴眼睛装作什么也没听到的表情，是又羞又气，道：“小屁孩，看什么看，想找打是不是？还不赶紧起来，趁着我妈去厨房做饭还不赶紧走？”

“哦哦……好……可是，竹姐姐，这个……你还要不要？”

苏林晃了晃抓在手上的黄瓜，一脸坏笑地说道。而叶星竹一看到这个，立马脸刷的一下就红透了，将苏林手中的黄瓜夺了下来，然后一把将苏林推了起来：“小屁孩，今天你什么都没有看到，什么也没有听到，赶紧给我滚出去。”

“至于这样么？竹姐姐，咱俩谁跟谁，有必要这么斤斤计较么？”

恋恋不舍地，苏林从浴缸里面撑了起来，发现自己身上从头到脚都湿透了。湿哒哒的，衣服黏在身上的感觉很不好，不过能够一睹竹姐姐的旖旎风光，而且还一起挤在同一个浴缸当中，这滋味，却也完全值得了。

见到苏林都起来了，还盯着自己的身上看，叶星竹赶紧用浴巾包裹住自己的身体，然后慢慢地从浴缸当中站了起来。蒙蒙的水汽，湿哒哒的头发，空气中一股特有的少女气息，叶星竹仿佛一朵出水芙蓉一般，让苏林看了直流口水。

白色的浴巾裹在身上，显得有些短了，所以只能够勉强将叶星竹的三点部位紧紧裹住。但是就是这样半遮半掩地，更加让苏林遐想非凡，想象空间无限，眼睛一眨不眨地盯着叶星竹。想象着那紧裹着的浴巾，宽松的下摆里面什么都没有穿，可是中空的，苏林直接就看呆了。

“小屁孩，转过身去，姐姐要换上班的衣服，你……不许偷看，知道不？”

狠狠地瞪了苏林一眼，叶星竹拿起了挂在卫生间的衣服，那是她晚上夜班医院的护士制服。而苏林一瞅这些衣服，白色的胸衣，蕾丝边小内裤，还有一身雪白的护士套装，只能够不情愿地转过身去。

“不准偷看，敢看的话，姐姐就把你两只眼睛挖出来，当炮踩。”

悉悉索索，在苏林转过去以后，叶星竹慢慢解开浴巾，将身上还有水珠的地方都擦干，然后一甩头发，开始将穿上内衣和蕾丝边小内裤。

而这对于苏林来说却是天大的折磨又是极度的享受，眼不见而耳愈聪，听着叶星竹这悉悉索索穿衣的动静，苏林心里面那个痒啊！却又没办法挠。

或者用时间暂停？苏林内心邪恶地想着，不过那暂停的时间宝贵，苏林可不想这么随随便便地就用掉。

微微侧了侧头，看向了旁边的梳妆镜，苏林一阵窃喜，因为从梳妆镜反射过来的影像能够隐隐约约地看到竹姐姐的身影。不过就是因为水汽的问题，镜子朦朦胧胧的，只能够看到大概的轮廓。

但，就是这样，才更加的诱惑，更加的让人抓耳挠腮，欲罢不能。

朦胧的镜像当中，苏林目不转睛地盯着，竹姐姐那雪白而玲珑的身段，慢慢地，慢慢地，将那些衣服一件一件地套在身上，简直是太诱人了。

苏林都看呆了，以至于竹姐姐都穿好了，一拍他的后背：“看够了没有，臭小子，别以为我不知道你借着镜子的反光偷看。”

刚刚在浴缸里，看也被苏林看光了，摸也被苏林摸透了，再加上“那事儿”也被苏林撞见了。叶星竹反倒是破罐子破摔，哪里还会计较苏林这借着镜子看她了呢？

“我哪里是偷看，竹姐姐，我苏林做事光明磊落，要看就光明正大的看……”

苏林拍了拍自己的胸脯，转过身来，一看叶星竹却是又呆了。

太美了，穿上了护士装的竹姐姐，头发还湿哒哒地甩在一边，小护士装是到膝盖的短裙，格外的修身，尤其是竹姐姐胸前地那一对傲人地小白兔，都似乎要将护士服撑爆了。

现在穿上了衣服，被苏林这么看着，叶星竹反倒是不避讳了，甚至还挺了挺胸，然后打开卫生间的门，回头对苏林吩咐道：“臭小子，你在里面看着，我在客厅给你打手势，安全了你就赶紧滚回家去，听到没有……千万不能让我妈看到……不然你就死定了。”

苏林头点得和小鸡啄米一样，看着叶星竹走到卧室，对着他做了一个安全的手势，然后苏林就马不停蹄，一溜烟地从卫生间跑了出来，直接从叶家跑回了自己家中。

身上的衣服湿哒哒的，还好现在爸妈还没有回来，苏林赶紧换了一身衣服。等他刚将衣服丢到洗衣机的时候，母亲刘爱珍就下班买菜回来了。

“妈，你回来了？今天吃什么好吃的？”

看着母亲手里提溜着的那些好菜，苏林赶紧殷勤地上前接过了菜篮子。

“小兔崽子，书就不好好读，一天到晚就知道玩。”

刘爱珍是一看到儿子苏林就来气，本来苏林的成绩能够考上一中是不错的，可是高中这三年苏林就是不知道用功读书，现在都高三马上要高考了，成绩还是吊儿郎当连个二本都可能考不上。

“明天是最后一次模拟考试了，妈买了点排骨炖给你吃，你再不给老娘争点气，高中毕业以后就跟你那些堂哥一样去东广省打工……”

恨铁不成钢，从小学到初中，苏林的成绩一直不错，虽然工作累点苦点，但是刘爱珍在亲戚朋友面前也算有骄傲的资本。日子也有盼头，就等着苏林考上大学出人头地。可是到了高中，苏林的成绩一落千丈，连带着刘爱珍在亲戚朋友面前都抬不起头来了。

听到母亲这话，苏林的心里面也是咯噔了一下。虽然说这个问题他也考虑过，但是现在离高考已经不到一个月了，要是真的没能够考好，只上了三本的分数线，那高昂的学费如何是自己家庭能够承受得起的？

“哎……小林，妈昨天晚上和你爸说了一宿。你也知道你奶奶这几年生病花了不少钱，虽然有你大伯和几个叔叔均摊，但是我们家也花了不少。几张存折加起来也才四五万块，如果是那种一年两三万学费的三本学校，出来也照样找不到什么工作，你爸也觉得，这样的话还不如不上……”

换了一种语气，刘爱珍叹了口气，语重心长地说道，“你也已经老大不小了，从你上高中以来，妈是打也打了，骂也骂了，最后高考怎么样，就看你自己了。考不上本二的学校，就只能够去打工了。”

其实刘爱珍也很无奈，谁不想自己的儿子上大学，出人头地啊！可是就苏家的这个家境，根本负担不起那么高昂的学费和生活费了。

苏林也意识到问题的严重性，一直以来他都在逃避这个问题，可是现在高考马上就来了，如果真的考不上好的学校，就只能够去打工了。而且，苏林看了看自己母亲那已经鬓白的头发，想到母亲这么大年纪了，还赚钱养家每天去工厂里做活，心也募地一下痛了。

“妈去做饭，不说了。你自己好好想想。”

坐在客厅沙发上，苏林看着厨房母亲忙碌的身影，自己也陷入了沉思。

“以我现在的成绩，拼死了也只能够考四百多分，顶多够上三本学校，可是三本学校学费那么贵。高考就剩下二十多天了，我再怎么努力也来不及了……”

自己有几斤几两，苏林还是知道的，荒废了那么久的学业，要一下子一飞冲天，正常来说根本不可能。

“咦？不对……正常来说我想提高成绩很难了，可是我不是刚刚获得了超能力，我可是能够暂停时间的，如果在高考考试的时候，我只要把时间暂停住，还怕考不好么？”

灵光一现，苏林想到这一点，自己的心脏也猛烈跳动了起来。利用自己能够暂停时间的神奇能力，高考要获得一个好成绩还不容易么？

Volume 1: Boy Cha’s Classmate Chapter 6: Miraculous Ability

Su Lin in the bathtub watched in surprise as the number skyrocketed.

"If according to my previous speculation, my magical ability to pause time is limited, it depends on the size of this bright red number, then this number has almost increased to one hundred. Does it mean that now I have the ability to pause time again?"

Thinking of this, Su Lin felt excited. He originally came to Ye Xingzhu to study his magical ability to pause time.But now, the numbers have increased back, and are even much higher than before. With the idea of giving it a try, Su Lin silently said again in his heart: "Time pauses."

It was that familiar feeling again, time paused, really paused again. Su Lin even saw a crystal drop of water falling from Sister Zhu's hair and staying in mid-air.

Time really paused, and at the same time, the bright red number in the upper right corner also began to decrease second by second.

The numbers that had gone up for some unknown reason began to decrease again. Sulin was very precious about these numbers. Now that the experiment was over, he quickly recited silently in his heart: "Time is restored."

Suddenly, time returned to normal.The quarrel between Ye Mu and Ye Xingzhu was still going on just now, but Ye Xingzhu didn't say much because of Su Lin's presence. Instead, Ye Mu kept talking tirelessly.

"Zhu'er... I won't say much else. It's not easy for Mom to support you for so many years. Now that you are working and can support yourself, Mom doesn't worry about anything else. She only worries about your life-long affairs. Mom has told the workers in the factory these days to ask them to check out their relatives and other things around them. If there are any good young men, I will introduce them to you..."

Ye Mu stood up, lifted her pants, and spoke earnestly.

However, Ye Xingzhu seemed to be very disgusted. He pouted and retorted: "Mom! I don't want a blind date. This is the 21st century. I make my own decisions about my own marriage."

"Yes, yes... let you make your own decision. You have been working for two or three years, and I haven't seen anyone brought back by you? Look at the Lili next door. She has been changed several times this year, and each one has better conditions than the last..."

Su Lin listened to the conversation quietly. It was obvious that this was a topic that the Ye family's mother and daughter often argued about.Although Su Lin wanted to say a few words for Sister Zhu now, as soon as he spoke, he was completely exposed.

"Okay, naughty girl, after Mom stops talking about you, you have to take care of your own affairs. If you can't find a decent young man to come back this year, Mom will arrange a blind date for you. Mom has gone to cook, you have to do it yourself, and after you finish it, come out to eat so you can go to work..."

After saying a few words, Ye Mu opened the bathroom door and went to the kitchen to cook without waiting for Ye Xingzhu to reply.

Ye Xingzhu wanted to explain, but Ye Mu had already gone out.And Ye Xingzhu looked down at Su Lin's expression with a evil smile and blinking eyes as if he didn't hear anything. He was ashamed and angry, and said: "Little brat, what are you looking at? Are you looking for a beating? Why don't you get up quickly and leave while my mother goes to the kitchen to cook?"

"Oh...ok...but, Sister Zhu, do you still want this...?"

Su Lin shook the cucumber in his hand and said with a wicked smile.When Ye Xingzhu saw this, his face immediately turned red. He snatched the cucumber from Su Lin's hand and pushed Su Lin up: "Little brat, you didn't see or hear anything today. Get out of here."

"As for this? Sister Zhu, is it necessary for us to be so fussy about who is following whom?"

Reluctantly, Su Lin stood up from the bathtub and found that he was soaked from head to toe.It was wet, and the feeling of clothes sticking to my body was unpleasant, but being able to see Sister Zhu's beautiful scenery and being squeezed into the same bathtub together was completely worth it.

Seeing that Su Lin was up and still staring at himself, Ye Xingzhu quickly wrapped his body in a bath towel, and then slowly stood up from the bathtub.The misty water vapor, wet hair, and a unique girlish scent in the air made Ye Xingzhu look like a water-blooming hibiscus, which made Su Lin drool at the sight.

The white bath towel wrapped around her body seemed a bit short, so it could only wrap Ye Xingzhu's three o'clock areas tightly.But being half-covered like this made Su Lin's reverie even more extraordinary. His imagination was unlimited, and he stared at Ye Xingzhu unblinkingly.Thinking of the tightly wrapped bath towel, with nothing underneath the loose hem, but hollow, Su Lin was stunned.

"Little brat, turn around. My sister is changing into work clothes. You... are not allowed to peek, do you understand?"

Staring at Su Lin fiercely, Ye Xingzhu picked up the clothes hanging in the bathroom. It was her nurse's uniform for the night shift hospital.When Su Lin took a look at these clothes, a white bra, lace panties, and a snow-white nurse suit, he could only turn around reluctantly.

"Don't peek. If you dare to peek, my sister will dig out your eyes and use them as cannons."

After a while, after Su Lin turned around, Ye Xingzhu slowly untied the bath towel, wiped off all the water droplets on his body, then flicked his hair and began to put on his underwear and lace panties.

But for Su Lin, this was a huge torture and an extreme enjoyment. Without seeing, the ears became clearer. Listening to Ye Xingzhu's movements of getting dressed, Su Lin felt itchy in his heart!But there was no way to scratch it.

Or pause with time?Su Lin thought evilly in his heart, but the pause time was precious, and Su Lin didn't want to use it so casually.

Su Lin turned his head slightly and looked at the dressing mirror next to him. He was secretly happy because the image reflected from the dressing mirror could vaguely see Sister Zhu's figure.However, due to the problem of water vapor, the mirror is hazy and only a rough outline can be seen.

But, just like this, it becomes even more tempting, making people scratch their heads even more, and they can't stop.

In the hazy mirror image, Su Lin stared intently at Sister Zhu's snow-white and exquisite figure. Slowly, slowly, she put those clothes on her body one by one. It was simply too tempting.

Su Lin was so stunned that Sister Zhu even put on his clothes and patted him on the back: "Have you seen enough, brat? Don't think I don't know you peeked through the reflection of the mirror."

Just now in the bathtub, Su Lin had seen everything, and Su Lin had touched everything. In addition, Su Lin also caught up with "that thing".Ye Xingzhu, on the other hand, was so broken that he couldn't care less about Su Lin looking at her through the mirror?

"I'm not peeping, Sister Zhu. I, Su Lin, do things openly and aboveboard. If you want to see it, just do it openly..."

Su Lin patted his chest and turned around. When he saw Ye Xingzhu, he was stunned again.

It’s so beautiful. Sister Zhu is wearing a nurse uniform, her hair is still wet and swung to the side. The nurse uniform is a short skirt that reaches the knees, which is particularly slim. Especially the pair of proud little white rabbits on Sister Zhu’s chest seem to burst the nurse uniform.

Now that he was wearing clothes and being looked at by Su Lin like this, Ye Xingzhu didn't shy away from it. He even straightened his chest. Then he opened the bathroom door and turned around and ordered Su Lin: "You brat, you watch from inside. I'll give you a sign in the living room. If it's safe, you can go home. If you hear me... don't let my mother see... or you'll be dead."

Su Lin nodded like a chicken pecking at rice. He watched Ye Xingzhu walk to the bedroom and made a safe gesture to him. Then Su Lin ran out of the bathroom without stopping and ran directly from Ye's house back to his home.

The clothes on his body were wet. Fortunately, his parents hadn't come back yet, so Su Lin quickly changed his clothes.When he just threw the clothes into the washing machine, his mother Liu Aizhen came back from get off work to buy groceries.

"Mom, are you back? What's something delicious to eat today?"

Looking at the delicious vegetables in his mother's hands, Su Lin quickly stepped forward and took over the basket.

"You little bastard, you can't read books well. You only know how to play all day long."

Liu Aizhen got angry when she saw her son Su Lin. Originally, Su Lin's grades were good enough to pass the No. 1 middle school, but Su Lin just didn't know how to study hard during the three years of high school. Now that he is in his senior year and is about to take the college entrance examination, his grades are still so lame that he might not even be able to pass the second grade.

"Tomorrow is the last mock exam. Mom bought some pork ribs to stew for you to eat. If you don't make me proud, after graduating from high school, you will go to Dongguang Province to work like your cousins..."

Hating that iron cannot be made into steel, Su Lin's grades have always been good from elementary school to junior high school. Although the work is tiring and difficult, Liu Aizhen is still proud of her relatives and friends.There is hope for life, just waiting for Su Lin to be admitted to university and make a difference.But in high school, Su Lin's grades plummeted, and even Liu Aizhen couldn't hold her head high in front of relatives and friends.

Hearing his mother's words, Su Lin's heart skipped a beat.Although he has considered this issue, it is now less than a month before the college entrance examination. If he really fails to do well in the exam and only passes the score line of three books, how can his family afford the high tuition?

"Hey...Xiao Lin, mom talked to your dad last night. You also know that your grandma has spent a lot of money on illness in the past few years. Although your uncle and several uncles have shared it equally, our family also spent a lot of money. The total of several bankbooks is only 40,000 to 50,000 yuan. If you go to one of the three schools with a tuition of 20,000 to 30,000 yuan a year, you still can't find a job. Your dad also thinks that it is better not to go to..."

Changing her tone, Liu Aizhen sighed and said earnestly, "You are already quite old. Ever since you entered high school, your mother has beaten you and scolded you. In the end, how you do in the college entrance examination depends on you. If you can't get into a second-level school, you can only work part-time."

In fact, Liu Aizhen is also very helpless. Who doesn’t want their son to go to college and get ahead?But the Su family's family cannot afford such high tuition and living expenses.

Su Lin also realized the seriousness of the problem. He had been avoiding this problem all along, but now the college entrance examination was coming soon. If he really couldn't get into a good school, he would have to work part-time.Moreover, Su Lin looked at his mother's hair, which was already gray. His heart ached when he thought that his mother, at such an old age, was still making money to support the family and working in the factory every day.

"Mom is going to cook, don't talk anymore. Think about it yourself."

Sitting on the sofa in the living room, Su Lin looked at his mother's busy figure in the kitchen and fell into deep thought.

"With my current grades, I can only score over 400 points no matter how hard I try, which is enough to attend three schools at most, but the tuition fees of the three schools are so expensive. There are only more than 20 days left for the college entrance examination, and no matter how hard I try, it will be too late..."

Su Lin still knew how much he weighed. After wasting his studies for so long, it would be impossible for him to skyrocket all of a sudden.

"Huh? No... Normally it would be difficult for me to improve my grades, but I didn't just gain superpowers. I can pause time. If I just pause time during the college entrance examination, am I still worried about failing the test?"

Suddenly, Su Lin thought of this, and his heart began to beat violently.Isn't it easy to get a good score in the college entrance examination by using your magical ability to pause time?
